verdict.rationale: Figma documents official developer surfaces to build against. These include the Plugin API with read/write access to editor contents and a Widgets API. The REST API covers files, webhooks, variables and library analytics, and Figma publishes an official OpenAPI spec with TypeScript types on GitHub. The official Code Connect library and CLI (with a React guide) round this out. Missing for 10: dedicated official REST client SDKs across multiple languages, an OpenAPI spec served from the developer site (probe paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
